title: The Watch Hill
subtitle: A location box, drawn to scale
description: The survey camps are boxes on the sheet, and the quest makes it
literal: a `location` task with a `position` corner and a `size`,
and `ignoreDimension: true` because the example does not presume
to know which world the survey walked.
A pack writing this for its own map names the dimension and draws
the box its camp really occupies. The field is the difference
between 'visit the place' and 'be inside this rectangle'.
